questions.text: Does the manufacturer publish the full composition of the product?
questions.hint: Look for a complete material list of the luminaire, including housing, diffuser and electronics.

questions.text: Are the materials used to produce the luminaire from responsible sources or recycling, and do they have a low environmental impact?
questions.hint: Look for recycled-content figures, certified wood, recycled aluminium or similar statements.

questions.text: Is the luminaire made of materials with very high corrosion resistance, including resistance to acids and toxic gases, which increases durability and limits frequent replacement?
questions.hint: Look for corrosion-resistance claims, material grades (e.g. stainless steel, marine-grade aluminium) or relevant tests.

questions.text: Was the product manufactured in the same region of the world where it is sold (local/regional production)?
questions.hint: Compare the country of manufacture with the market of the sale page.

questions.text: Does the manufacturer publish carbon footprint data (Carbon Footprint)?
questions.hint: Look for a stated CO2e value, an EPD or an LCA summary.

questions.text: Is the luminaire designed to take up little volume during transport, which reduces the carbon footprint?
questions.hint: Look for compact or flat-pack design, or packaging dimensions that suggest it.

questions.text: Is the luminaire produced using recycled materials?
questions.hint: Look for recycled-content statements for the luminaire's materials.

questions.text: Does the manufacturer provide information on energy use or emissions in the production process?
questions.hint: Look for production energy or emissions data, or an environmental declaration.

questions.text: Are the luminaire and light source designed so that they do not require additional chemical impregnation or harmful coatings (e.g. fire-retardant, anti-corrosion) to ensure safety and durability?
questions.hint: Answer 'yes' if no harmful extra coatings are needed or used. Answer 'no' if such coatings are stated.

questions.text: Is the product marked with the WEEE symbol, indicating the need for separate collection of electrical waste?
questions.hint: Look for the crossed-out wheelie bin symbol or a WEEE mention in the product documentation.

questions.text: Does the luminaire contain elements that can be easily separated for recycling (e.g. aluminium, glass)?
questions.hint: Look for design-for-disassembly statements or a materials list showing separable recyclable parts.

questions.text: Is the product free from substances particularly harmful to the environment (in accordance with RoHS)?
questions.hint: Look for a RoHS compliance statement or CE declaration that covers it.

questions.text: Does the luminaire have impact resistance of 5 J energy, which increases its durability and limits the need for frequent replacement?
questions.hint: Answer 'yes' for IK08 or higher (5 J). A lower IK rating is 'no'. No rating is 'unknown'.
